description: orders equal-priority tasks reproducibly using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded seeded priority order result when an agent needs a reproducible decision that another run can independently replay. Returns the deterministic selection plus seed provenance, population bounds, and the operation-specific outcome for Seeded Priority Order as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Uses Python pseudorandomness for reproducibility, not cryptography, lotteries with value, security tokens, gambling, or custody.

seed.description: Seed supplied to Seeded Priority Order; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

tasks.description: Tasks supplied to Seeded Priority Order; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.
